name: HireFlow - Mail to Visible Browser + Slack

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Silent poll every 10s. Workflow runs ONLY when a new matching email arrives — not on empty polls.

nodes.name: Login HireFlow API
nodes.notes: Same account as backend .env HF_EMAIL / HF_PASSWORD

nodes.name: Open Browser + Run HireFlow
nodes.notes: HireFlow UI only. Slack opens after Notify so the posted message is visible.

nodes.name: Show Slack in Browser
nodes.notes: Opens Slack after the message is posted so you can see it live.
